attributes.action:
Title

Change the law to require asylum claims in the first safe country
attributes.additional_details:
Why do you want this?

I believe these changes would strengthen border security, improve public confidence in the immigration system, and ensure that the UK’s asylum system focuses on those most in need of protection while improving public safety for the British citizens.
attributes.background: Introduce legislation requiring people seeking asylum to claim protection in the first safe country they reach after leaving their home country. Individuals who travel through multiple safe countries without claiming asylum should not normally be eligible to claim asylum in the UK.

rejection.details:
The UK government’s position is that refugees should claim asylum in the first safe country they reach.

In addition, the law already allows for the Home Secretary to declare an asylum claim inadmissible if the person “has a connection to a safe third State”.

You can read more about this here: https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2002/41/section/80B
